Container.Name: keystone-db
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 16 — Keystone's tenant-private datastore (row-level security). Stock postgres (NOT TimescaleDB — Keystone's schema is relational multi-tenant, no hypertables), VERSION-PINNED: this template names an exact postgres version; DB updates are deliberate (back up first), never a moving tag. ONE neutral template for dev and prod: at creation set Name (keystone-db / keystone-db-dev), network + a static IP if you use one, the data path on a pool, and POSTGRES_PASSWORD. Autostart this DB BEFORE the keystone app container; the app's DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME must match this container's IP + POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB.
Container.Description: PostgreSQL 16 for Keystone (version-pinned). Neutral template; set Name (keystone-db / keystone-db-dev), IP + POSTGRES_PASSWORD at creation.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Postgres data dir. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL, NOT the user-share FUSE overlay.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: DB password (set at creation; reuse as the app's DB_PASSWORD)
